lines.zh: 踏着沉重的步伐，我漫步于秘界之尘中。
lines.en: I stride through the dust of the秘界, each step heavy.

lines.zh: 我的脚步震动着地面，回响在这古老之地。
lines.en: My steps shake the ground, echoing through this ancient land.

lines.zh: 我穿越秘界，寻找着未知的秘密。
lines.en: I traverse the秘界, seeking unknown secrets.

lines.zh: 我的脚步沉重，踏过无数岁月的痕迹。
lines.en: My steps are heavy, trampling countless years.

lines.zh: 在这密布的阴影中，我缓缓前行。
lines.en: I move slowly in this shadowy maze.

lines.zh: 秘界中我的脚步回荡，仿佛回响千年的呼唤。
lines.en: My footsteps echo in the秘界, as if calling through millennia.

lines.zh: 我在这迷宫中行走，寻找着最终的真相。
lines.en: I walk through this maze, seeking the ultimate truth.

lines.zh: 每一步都踏在岁月的尘埃上，我从未停下。
lines.en: I never stop, each step on the dust of time.

lines.zh: 在这无尽的秘界中，我不断前行。
lines.en: I move endlessly in this endless秘界.

lines.zh: 我的步伐坚定，穿越了千年的遗忘。
lines.en: My steps are firm, crossing millennia of forgetfulness.

lines.zh: 我站在黑暗中，等待着猎物的到来。
lines.en: I stand in darkness, waiting for prey to come.

lines.zh: 我的目光深邃，如同无尽的虚空。
lines.en: My gaze is deep, like the void itself.

lines.zh: 在这静谧的时刻，我能感知到你的存在。
lines.en: In this moment of silence, I sense your presence.

lines.zh: 我的眼神锐利，仿佛能洞察一切。
lines.en: My eyes are sharp, piercing through all.

lines.zh: 我在这里驻足，静候着猎物的出现。
lines.en: I pause here, waiting for prey to appear.

lines.zh: 我的目光扫过每一个角落，寻找着弱点。
lines.en: My gaze sweeps each corner, searching for weakness.

lines.zh: 我静默无言，等待着猎物的出现。
lines.en: I remain silent, waiting for prey to come.

lines.zh: 我的眼神锐利，搜寻着每一个可能的目标。
lines.en: My eyes are sharp, searching every possible target.

lines.zh: 我驻足于此，凝视着每一个角落。
lines.en: I pause here, gazing into every corner.

lines.zh: 我静静等待，寻找着猎物的踪迹。
lines.en: I wait quietly, searching for prey's trail.

lines.zh: 这间房里的货，我摆了三百年。
lines.en: I have kept this room's wares for three hundred years.

lines.zh: 秘界的门开了又合，我还在。
lines.en: The doors of the realm open and close; I remain.

lines.zh: 我等一个肯出价的客人。
lines.en: I wait for a customer willing to pay.

lines.zh: 我的柜台比这世界的石头还老。
lines.en: My counter is older than this world's stone.

lines.zh: 千年的寿命，不如一场好买卖。
lines.en: A thousand years of life is worth less than a good trade.

lines.zh: 我数着房间里的尘埃落定。
lines.en: I count the dust as it settles in my room.

lines.zh: 我感受到了你的气息，猎物已经近在咫尺。
lines.en: I sense your presence, prey is close.

lines.zh: 你在这里，我看到了你的身影。
lines.en: You are here, I see your form.

lines.zh: 你的存在令我警觉，猎物来了。
lines.en: Your presence alerts me, prey has come.

lines.zh: 我盯着你，猎物就在眼前。
lines.en: I focus on you, prey is in sight.

lines.zh: 你终于出现了，猎物就在这里。
lines.en: You have appeared, prey is here.

lines.zh: 你的动作暴露了你，猎物已现。
lines.en: Your movements betray you, prey revealed.

lines.zh: 我的视线锁定在你身上，猎物就在你周围。
lines.en: My gaze locks on you, prey around you.

lines.zh: 你的存在让我兴奋，猎物就在不远处。
lines.en: Your presence excites me, prey nearby.

lines.zh: 我的视线锁定你，猎物就在你身边。
lines.en: My gaze is on you, prey by your side.

lines.zh: 你在这里，我感受到了你的气息。
lines.en: You are here, I sense your presence.
I look up, and my eyes go to your purse first.

lines.zh: 你身上有值得一换的东西。
lines.en: You carry something worth a trade.
The lord's flesh is torn!
The giant roars in pain!
My strength is diminished!
My heart trembles!
The dark power fades!
I'm severely wounded!
I can't fight anymore!
My source of life is damaged!

lines.zh: 秘界的货，还没交到你手上。
lines.en: The goods of the Secret Realm are not yet yours.
My rule is threatened!

lines.zh: 你那剑光闪烁，却伤不到我分毫！
lines.en: Your blade glitters, but it can't harm me!

lines.zh: 贪婪的人类，用你的智慧来交换吧！
lines.en: Human of greed, trade with your wits!

lines.zh: 我的领地，不是你轻易能得的！
lines.en: My domain, not yours to take!

lines.zh: 享受你所拥有的，但别奢望更多！
lines.en: Enjoy what you have, but don't desire more!

lines.zh: 你的宝藏，不过是尘埃里的渺小！
lines.en: Your treasures, mere dust and pebbles!

lines.zh: 用你的心去感悟，我为何如此强大！
lines.en: Feel the power within my heart!

lines.zh: 与我争斗吧，证明你的价值！
lines.en: Fight me, prove your worth!

lines.zh: 交易吧，否则你将面对更艰难的选择！
lines.en: Trade with me, or face tougher choices!

lines.zh: 我将展现力量，你却只能屈服！
lines.en: I will show power, and you will bow!

lines.zh: 你无法战胜我，只能接受命运！
lines.en: You can't defeat me, accept your fate!

lines.zh: 你挡在了我与自由之间！
lines.en: You stand in my way to freedom!
Dare to block my path?!

lines.zh: 用你的身躯，铺平我的道路！
lines.en: Use your body to clear my path!

lines.zh: 我的爪击，将粉碎你的抵抗！
lines.en: My claws will shatter your resistance!

lines.zh: 你太弱了，连碰都不能碰我！
lines.en: You are too weak to touch me!

lines.zh: 用你的头颅，证明你的力量！
lines.en: Prove your strength with your head!

lines.zh: 别阻拦我，否则你会后悔的！
lines.en: Don't block me, or you'll regret it!

lines.zh: 我的力量，将碾碎你的身躯！
lines.en: My power will crush your body!
Move, or I'll be enraged!
You can't stop my steps!
Will you be my mate?
You'll share my glory.

lines.zh: 我们的力量，将更加强大。
lines.en: Our strength will be greater.
Sleep with me, in the night.

lines.zh: 只有你才能理解我的世界。
lines.en: Only you can understand my world.

lines.zh: 我的生命，将因你而完整。
lines.en: My life will be complete with you.
Live with me, never apart.
You'll be my only one.
Let's create a future together.
You'll be my eternal mate.
My power comes from the depths!

lines.zh: 地上每枚硬币，都记在我账上。
lines.en: Every coin on this floor is on my ledger.
Taste my might!
I am the Lord of the Abyss!
You shall yield!
This armor was bought with interest.

lines.zh: 秘界的尘土里，我捡起一枚硬币。
lines.en: In the dust of the Arcana I pick up a coin.
This room is mine!
I am Lord Vatticus!
Here lies my treasure!

lines.zh: 你身上的附魔，我出价了。
lines.en: I bid on the enchantments you carry.
Watch my claws!
Business is business—look at the goods first.

lines.zh: 秘界的房间里，触须先伸。
lines.en: In the secret realm's room, tentacles first.

lines.zh: 享受你的末日吧，秘界的交易到此为止。
lines.en: Enjoy your doom; trading in the Arcana ends here.
Trade or fight. Choose first.
Your death shall bring honor!
My existence is punishment!
You cannot escape me!
Come, let me end you!

lines.zh: 客人进了我的房，就不许空手走。
lines.en: No guest leaves my room empty-handed.
Your gear has caught my eye.
I set the rules of this room.
We discuss the price before your life.
I shall drain your strength!
The bolt drops; this deal must be settled.
Feel my rage!

lines.zh: 秘界的房间里，交易之外还有别的。
lines.en: Beyond trade, this room has other options.
Your bill is pinned under my counter.
This is how you die!
My attacks cannot be stopped!
Your pain will end soon!
Let me judge you!
This is your moment of judgment!

lines.zh: 我按住柜台的刀柄，等你开口。
lines.en: I rest my hand on the blade at the counter.
If you will not buy, I will take it myself.
Can you afford this price?

lines.zh: 我算过你的护甲值几个钱。
lines.en: I have priced your armor already.
The door of this room is barred.
You have one option left.
Rumble shakes the ground
Wings flap, rocks fly
Sharp claws tear the air
Dark wings sweep overhead
Roar shakes the earth
Flames burn in his eyes
Crushes all beneath his feet
Sword cleaves the stone

lines.zh: 咆哮中的牙齿锋利如刃
lines.en: Raging teeth sharp as blades
Leaps high into the air
I flip the counter and splinters fly.

lines.zh: 这一爪算是给你的折扣。
lines.en: This claw is your discount.

lines.zh: 欠账的客人，得留下点东西。
lines.en: Debtors must leave something behind.
What I take is not coin but strength.
Appears in the secret realm
Steps from a dark crack
Appears slowly in the fog
Rises slowly from the abyss
Arrives with shadows
Crawls up from deep underground
Gradually appears in the dark
Appears slowly in the dark
Appears slowly from a crack
Emerges from a crack in the ground

lines.zh: 秘界的房间里，柜台后有人。
lines.en: In a room of the realm, someone stands behind the counter.

lines.zh: 我在这间房等了你很久。
lines.en: I have waited in this room a long while.

lines.zh: 门一推开，我的目光就到了。
lines.en: The door opens and my gaze arrives.

lines.zh: 百年的灰尘，随我起身扬起。
lines.en: A century of dust rises as I stand.
I am the keeper of this room's goods.
The realm gave me a patch of ground.

lines.zh: 瓦提克斯领主，开门营业。
lines.en: Lord Vatticus is open for business.
The lamp in the stone chamber lights up.

lines.zh: 我抬了抬眼皮，算作招呼。
lines.en: I lift an eyelid by way of greeting.

lines.zh: 又一个闯进秘界的客人。
lines.en: Another guest blunders into the realm.
The flames burn my skin!
Fell from a height, badly injured!
Drowned, barely alive!
The explosion tore my body!
A projectile hit me!

lines.zh: 魔法术士的咒语将我灼伤！
lines.en: A magic spell burns me!

lines.zh: 空柜台撑不起这场交易。
lines.en: An empty counter can't sustain this deal.
Lightning strikes me!

lines.zh: 虚空的深渊吞噬了我的生命力！
lines.en: The void devours my life force!
